scope: SPI0 documented power-of-two SCK divider values 2 through 256 are silicon-qualified in the inherited HSI clock state. The APB reset pulse followed by a direct CTRL divider write read back the requested field, completed all 64 one-byte transfers at every point, and produced strictly monotonic MTIME latency. The former SDK sequence asserted CTRL.SOFT_RESET first; silicon then retained CTRL=0x00008202 and ignored every requested divider, explaining the earlier flat external capture. This qualifies relative divider behavior and the repaired init sequence, not an absolute SPI reference frequency, SPI1, odd/non-power-of-two values, RX, duplex, DUAL/QUAD, DMA, or clock switching. SRAM only; no flash writes; board reset after the run.

SPI0 mode-3 one-byte transmit behavior and analyzer-referenced external SCK are parity-qualified for every documented power-of-two divider 2 through 256 on the exact L48 SCK PIN_12, CSN PIN_13, and MOSI PIN_14 corridor. Apparatus was fixed in a separate non-parity 24-capture vendor session; the subsequent locked ensemble session passed four vendor images per ordinary-Verilog and explicit-IOB form plus both open images in 3/3. This extends the earlier relative MTIME sweep and divider-32 payload-width qualification. It is not PVT or oscillator-tolerance characterization and does not qualify SPI1, receive/duplex, odd dividers, dual/quad lanes, DMA/POLL/interrupt, other pins, or other packages. The documented hard CTRL register exposes no CPOL/CPHA selection fields. Control-first, SRAM only, zero flash writes, final reset.
